name: research-case
summary: Time-boxed research or analysis with many parallel agents and a written deliverable (memo, brief, deck notes). Typically no git; OneDrive/iCloud versioning.

work_folders.00_inputs/originals: what the human gave us — read-only
work_folders.00_inputs/extracted: plain-text extracts of the originals — agents read these
work_folders.01_context: brief, research questions, framework — derived from inputs at init
work_folders.02_research: one subfolder per stream, one file per agent and topic (finding template)
work_folders.03_synthesis: cross-stream comparison, patterns, mapping to the brief

init_questions: Who is the recipient of the deliverable and in what form (memo, slides, table)?
What are the research questions or streams? (I will derive them from the inputs if you point me to them.)
Which inputs are confidential and must never go into a web search?
